sweep_called_by_unauthorized.meaning: sweep() is invoked by a caller that is not the legitimate builderAdmin

wallet_tokens_drained.meaning: wallet tokens held by BuilderWallet are drained (loss of funds) as a result of the sweep() call

assumptions: The legitimate builderAdmin is a distinct party from the arbitrary attacker.
sweep() transfers or otherwise removes tokens held by BuilderWallet.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether sweep() itself enforces a builderAdmin-only check, so the guard-bypass mechanism for the unauthorized sweep is not established.
Report does not specify token amounts or types held by BuilderWallet, so the magnitude of the loss cannot be quantified.
Report does not establish that the attacker's sweep() call actually succeeded in a real transaction.

limitations: No precondition statements were supplied; the plan formalizes the access-control relation for the unauthorized sweep directly from the security intent and the loss_of_funds impact.
The loss_of_funds impact is represented as a Boolean drain outcome because the report gives no numeric amounts; magnitude is deferred to code binding.
The init() access-control gap and builderAdmin takeover are separate impacts handled in other claim-generation passes and are not formalized here.
